recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the part of the Applied resolution that was not present in the prior source application while leaving the already-correct condition comment unchanged.
issue_request: FHIR-46179 was an Applied/Persuasive CDS change request for PlanDefinition.action.condition. It asked to clarify that an action with no applicability conditions is applicable, that multiple conditions of the same kind use AND semantics, that different condition kinds are considered separately, and that an example show actions with no applicability criteria, multiple applicability criteria, and applicability/start/stop criteria.
initial_application: The Jira-linked PR HL7/fhir#3369 included commit b3c6ff5d9c086ed1795b48330f421d65da48ca4e, which updated the PlanDefinition.action.condition comment with the requested no-applicability, AND, and separate-kind semantics. That commit did not add a PlanDefinition example, and a current source scan found no PlanDefinition example using start or stop condition kinds.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes PlanDefinition as a current build resource, assigns it to CDS, and marks it approved, so source/plandefinition examples listed in list-PlanDefinition-examples.xml are in current build scope. The 2024-08-14 CDS agenda references FHIR-46179 among addressed Jira items, and direct Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion. No separate invariant was added because the applied resolution settled on clarifying prose plus an example rather than a structural prohibition.
reconciliation: Added source/plandefinition/plandefinition-condition-semantics-example.xml with three actions covering no applicability criteria, multiple applicability criteria, and applicability/start/stop criteria. Added the example to source/plandefinition/list-PlanDefinition-examples.xml so it is included with the PlanDefinition examples.
source_changes: source/plandefinition/plandefinition-condition-semantics-example.xml: added a focused PlanDefinition example with action condition sets [], [applicability, applicability], and [applicability, start, stop].
source/plandefinition/list-PlanDefinition-examples.xml: added the condition semantics example to the current PlanDefinition examples list.
